title.value: Turn vet charges into ready-to-send pet insurance claims

introduction.value: A personal OpenClaw agent spots vet charges in the bank feed, finds the invoice in Gmail, fills the insurer's PDF form, drafts the email and tracks replies for the owner to review and send.

method.value: The owner uploads a bank CSV by hand, since the agent never stores bank logins. On a 15-minute tick the agent flags vet charges, searches Gmail for the matching invoice, and uses an LLM (Gemini) to extract it, falling back to OCR for scans. It fills the Petcover PDF, creates a Gmail draft, and asks on Telegram when unsure. It never sends.

outcome.value: Across ten live approval letters, its settlement arithmetic check passed to the cent, and a second check raised questions on five. Early bugs: its own request emails false-matched 12 claims, and old acknowledgements pushed two settled claims backwards.

notes.value: Gmail OAuth in testing mode expires every 7 days, so you must re-authenticate regularly; the free Gemini tier needed a chain of fallback models once daily limits ran out.

source_text.body:
Turn vet charges into ready-to-send pet insurance claims
A personal OpenClaw agent spots vet charges in the bank feed, finds the invoice in Gmail, fills the insurer's PDF form, drafts the email and tracks replies for the owner to review and send.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
The owner uploads a bank CSV by hand, since the agent never stores bank logins. On a 15-minute tick the agent flags vet charges, searches Gmail for the matching invoice, and uses an LLM (Gemini) to extract it, falling back to OCR for scans. It fills the Petcover PDF, creates a Gmail draft, and asks on Telegram when unsure. It never sends.
How it went
Across ten live approval letters, its settlement arithmetic check passed to the cent, and a second check raised questions on five. Early bugs: its own request emails false-matched 12 claims, and old acknowledgements pushed two settled claims backwards.
Worth knowing
Gmail OAuth in testing mode expires every 7 days, so you must re-authenticate regularly; the free Gemini tier needed a chain of fallback models once daily limits ran out.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Scan my [bank account or statement] for vet charges from the last [timeframe], find the matching invoices in my email, and fill out [insurer]'s claim form with them. Draft the claim email with the form and invoice attached, and finish by showing me the drafted claim. Don't send anything until I approve it.
Original source: https://github.com/jagberg/Me.OpenClaw
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: This OpenClaw workflow prepares a claim for a person to send. Its boundary is unusually explicit: bank credentials stay out of the agent and outgoing email remains a draft.
introduction.zh: 这个OpenClaw流程为人准备理赔材料，边界较明确：不向agent保存银行凭据，外发邮件停留在草稿阶段。

method.en: A manually supplied bank CSV starts the matching process. Every fifteen minutes the workflow looks for veterinary charges, retrieves corresponding Gmail invoices, extracts fields with Gemini or OCR, populates a Petcover PDF and creates a Gmail draft. Uncertain matches are raised through Telegram.
method.zh: 用户手动提供银行CSV后，流程每十五分钟识别兽医支出、匹配Gmail发票，通过Gemini或OCR提取字段，填充Petcover PDF并建立Gmail草稿；不确定的匹配通过Telegram询问。

outcome.en: For ten real approval letters, the reported arithmetic check agreed to the cent; a separate check flagged five for questions. Those flags are review requests, not five proven insurer errors or five additional payouts.
outcome.zh: 在十份真实批准信上，据述算术核对精确到分；另一项检查对五份提出疑问。这些标记表示待复核，不能视为五次已证实的保险方错误或五笔额外赔款。

notes.en: The implementation initially confused its own request emails with twelve claims and let old acknowledgements regress two settled records. Testing-mode Gmail authorization needed weekly renewal, and free-model quotas required fallbacks. These are reported historical operating constraints, not current product guarantees.
notes.zh: 早期实现曾把自己发出的请求邮件误匹配为十二笔理赔，也曾因旧确认信让两笔已结案记录状态倒退。测试模式Gmail授权需每周续验，免费模型额度也要求备用模型。这些是历史运行约束，不是对当前产品规则的保证。

editorial.attribution: Original structured synthesis of source-reported facts and explicit evidence limits; not full text, a full translation, or independent outcome verification.

translation.body:
把兽医费用转成可发送的宠物保险理赔材料
一个个人OpenClaw agent从银行流水中识别兽医费用，在Gmail找到发票，填写保险公司的PDF表单，起草邮件并跟踪回复，供主人审阅和发送。
实际使用
OpenClaw
具体做法
主人手动上传银行CSV，因为agent从不保存银行登录凭据。agent每十五分钟运行一次，标记兽医费用，在Gmail搜索对应发票，并使用大语言模型Gemini提取内容；扫描件则回退使用OCR。它填写Petcover PDF，建立Gmail草稿，遇到不确定情况时通过Telegram询问。它从不发送邮件。
结果如何
在十份真实批准信上，它的结算算术检查准确到分；另一项检查对其中五份提出疑问。早期错误包括：把自己发出的请求邮件误匹配到十二笔理赔，以及旧的确认邮件让两笔已结算理赔的状态倒退。
值得知道
测试模式下的Gmail OAuth每七天失效，因此必须定期重新认证；免费Gemini额度在每日用尽后，需要一串备用模型来接续。
自行试用
推荐工具
OpenClaw
复制提示词
扫描我最近[时间范围]的[银行账户或对账单]，找出兽医费用，在邮件中找到相应发票，并用它们填写[保险公司]的理赔表。起草理赔邮件，附上表单与发票，最后向我展示理赔草稿。未经我批准，不要发送任何内容。
原始来源：https://github.com/jagberg/Me.OpenClaw
